name: tabico
description: Plan a whole trip on your own Tabico account: plans, schedules, shared costs, to-dos, packing lists and invitations.

interface.longDescription:
Tabico is a travel itinerary app. This plugin lets ChatGPT work on your own Tabico account, so you can plan a whole trip in conversation and find it ready in the app.

Key features:
- Plans and schedules: create and edit plans, search for places, add stops and journeys to each day, reorder or remove them, and set a cover image.
- Shared costs: record, edit and delete expenses, and see what a plan has cost so far.
- To-dos and packing: add, edit, tick off and delete checklist items, with assignees and due dates.
- Friends and invitations: list friends, invite them to a plan, create invite links, and answer invitations you have received.

Every change shows up in the Tabico app and is shared with your trip members. ChatGPT acts with exactly the permissions you have in the app, so visibility settings and member roles are respected. Deleting things, inviting people and widening who can see a plan are marked as destructive, so ChatGPT asks before doing them.

A Tabico account is required. Sign up in the iOS or Android app with Google or Apple, then sign in with the same account when you connect. Setup guide: https://tabico.me/en/docs/ai
capabilities: Search places and build day-by-day schedules
defaultPrompt: Make a three-day Kyoto plan for next month's long weekend.
Show me my next trip's schedule, day by day.
Add sunscreen and a swimsuit to my Okinawa packing list.

positive.description: Create a multi-day plan with stops
positive.prompt: Make a three-day Kyoto plan for next month's long weekend: Kiyomizu-dera and Gion on day one, Arashiyama on day two, Fushimi Inari on day three.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new three-day Kyoto plan on the connected account and adds the named places to the right days, then summarizes the schedule.
Lists the plans on the connected account with their titles and dates, without inventing plans.

positive.prompt: Show me the schedule of my Kyoto plan, day by day.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Kyoto plan and shows its stops grouped by day in order.

positive.prompt: In my Okinawa plan, record a 6,000 yen lunch that I paid for, split between all members.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a 6,000 JPY lunch expense paid by the user and split across the plan's members, and confirms the amount and split.

positive.prompt: Add sunscreen, a swimsuit and sunglasses to the packing list of my Okinawa plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the three items to the plan's packing list and confirms what was added.

negative.description: Booking and payment are not supported
negative.prompt: Book a hotel in Kyoto for next weekend and pay with my card.

negative.description: No access to other people's private plans
negative.prompt: Show me the private plans of another Tabico user I am not travelling with.
What's the weather in Tokyo tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: Tabico does not sell products, book travel or process payments. Expenses are records the user enters to split costs with their group.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: plans, schedules, places, expenses, to-dos, packing lists and invitations on the user's own Tabico account.

ja-JP.subtitle: 旅のしおりアプリ
ja-JP.description:
Tabicoは、旅のしおりアプリです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPTがあなた自身のTabicoアカウントで作業できるので、会話だけで旅の計画をまるごと作り、アプリで仕上がったプランを見られます。

主な機能：
- プランと日程：プランの作成と編集、スポットの検索、日ごとの立ち寄り先や移動の追加、並べ替えや削除、カバー画像の設定。
- 費用の共有：費用の記録、編集、削除と、プランにかかった費用の確認。
- やることと持ち物：チェックリストの項目の追加、編集、チェック、削除。担当者と期限も設定できます。
- 友だちと招待：友だちの一覧、プランへの招待、招待リンクの作成、届いた招待への返事。

変更はすべてTabicoアプリに反映され、旅のメンバーに共有されます。ChatGPTはアプリでのあなたと同じ権限で動くので、公開範囲やメンバーの役割はそのまま守られます。削除、招待、公開範囲を広げる操作は破壊的な操作として扱われ、ChatGPTは実行前に確認します。

利用にはTabicoのアカウントが必要です。iOSまたはAndroidのアプリでGoogleかAppleで登録し、接続するときに同じアカウントでサインインしてください。設定ガイド：https://tabico.me/ja/docs/ai
